source: ECharts 6.1 dist (echarts.js) under node, ssr init then _ssr = false, env.node = false

clock.settle: first render: frames to 3000 ms; static step: event, frames at NOW, NOW + 16, NOW + 300; animated step: event, frame at NOW

notes: An up step is handler.mouseup then handler.click at the same point.
hover is the role of handler.findHover before the event.
Every case but anim-* has option.animation false; the handle labels' blur still transitions (stateTransition 200 ms) and is settled at each record.

cases.note: vertical, realtime: the top handle down, the bottom one up; every move dispatches selectDataRange, hoverLink on the handle highlights
vertical, realtime false: no dispatch until the release (one there, even unmoved), no hoverLink on the handle
vertical inverse: the bar group is not flipped, a downward move raises the value of handle 0
horizontal: the bar is rotated pi/2, the drag reads dx through the inverted transform
horizontal inverse (rotation -pi/2)
a handle dragged past the other (cross is forbidden: they meet) and past the end of the bar (clamped)
a drag by the handle label moves its handle
the in-range bar dragged moves both ends ("all"); the dist reads _handleEnds["all"] for the hoverLink, NaN: every highlight goes
the in-range bar dragged, realtime false
hoverLinkOnHandle true with realtime false: the drag highlights the handle's neighbourhood
hoverLinkOnHandle false with realtime true: dispatches, no hoverLink from the handle
calculable false: no handles, the bar is not draggable; hover still links
formatter and precision 0 on the handle labels and the indicator
the pointer over the bar: the indicator with ≈, < and > near the ends, the highlight batches, the handle labels blurred; off the bar
a partial range: over the in-range and the out-of-range parts (each crossing is an out and an over: downplay all, highlight all)
horizontal: the indicator label above / below by the bar align
hoverLinkDataSize 20: the link spans 20 data units
over a handle (outside the bar width): no indicator; with realtime the handle links
hoverLink from the series: over a bar the indicator shows its value; leaving hides it
a series the visualMap does not target: no indicator; the targeted one: the indicator
hoverLink false: no indicator, no batches either way
a scatter behind a dataZoom window: the batch indices are the inner ones
a series with emphasis.focus series: the highlight blurs the other series
two visualMaps on one series: two highlight keys; downplay by one keeps what the other holds
selectDataRange from outside: the range (reversed, clamped), the view rebuilt, the event without from
a merge after a drag keeps the dragged range; a merge writing range replaces it; notMerge forgets
multiple (the default): each click toggles its piece; hovering an item highlights its data
single: a click selects only its piece
selectedMode true acts as single
selectedMode false: the items are silent -- no click, no hover link
pieces with an open end; a click on the open piece
categories: the key is the category
selectDataRange with a partial map: unnamed pieces are unselected (setSelected does not complete it); a merge resets
a merge writing `selected` replaces the map (_resetSelected takes the new one alone); a merge without it selects every piece again
animation on: the indicator slides 100 ms cubicInOut, additive, the moves 30 ms apart stack
animation on: the indicator follows the hovered data (fill animates too)

guards.detail: realtime false: a drag move dispatches nothing
the indicator from a data hover
a merge replaces the selected map
the dragged range survives a merge
the highlight blurs the other series
